Beautification Commission Meeting
Public Comment from the Audience
•
If you wish to address the Beautification Commission, please complete a Speaker Request Card, as it must be handed to the Recording Secretary before the start of the meeting.
•
The Beautification Commission will hear public comments on matters not listed on the agenda during the Public Comments from the Audience period.
•
Opportunity to address the Beautification Commission (on non-agenda items) is limited to 3 minutes per speaker.
•
The Beautification Commission will hear public comments on items listed on the agenda during discussion of the matter and prior to a vote.
Brown Act
Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The Beautification Commission may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain matters for consideration at a future Beautification Commission meeting.
Rules of Decorum
Persons attending the meeting shall observe rules of propriety, decorum, good conduct, and refrain from impertinent or slanderous remarks. Violation of this rule shall result in such persons being barred from further audience before the governing body. Pursuant to Gov. Code Sect. 54954.3(c), any person who engages in unlawful interference shall be removed from chambers.
Americans with Disabilities Act
In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, please contact the City Clerk's office at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to allow the City to make reasonable arrangements to ensure accessibility to the meeting or service.
This agenda was posted 72 hours in advance of the meeting at the City Hall, 8838 E. Valley Boulevard, Rosemead; the L.A. County Library, Rosemead Branch, 8800 E. Valley Boulevard, Rosemead; and other locations pursuant to RMC Sec. 1.08.020. Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the Rosemead Beautification Commission regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.

1.
PUBLIC COMMENTS FROM THE AUDIENCE Please refer to public comment guidelines on the first page of this document.
2.
PRESENTATION
CEQA: This item is not subject to the California Environmental Quality Act.
A.
Winners of the 2024 Beautification Awards
The Beautification Commission will announce the winners of the Beautification Awards in the following categories: Enchanted Entryway; The Rose Award;
Best Curb Appeal; and the Beautifying Rosemead Award.
3.
MATTERS FROM STAFF
CEQA: The following items are not subject to the California Environmental Quality Act.
A.
Discussion on Potential Civic Center Plaza Improvements
On November 14, 2023, the City Council discussed potential ideas for improving the Civic Center Plaza area. In concept, the idea was to create a better usable and active open space and park-like setting and increase parking amenities. Both underground and above-ground parking structure concepts were discussed.
At the request of Mayor Ly, staff is presenting the potential Civic Center Plaza improvements before the Beautification Commission.
Recommendation: That the Beautification Commission receive and file, and provide feedback.
Staff Report
B.
Senate Bill (SB) 1383 Programs in Rosemead
Staff from the Rosemead Public Works Department and Republic Services will provide an overview of SB 1383 Organic Waste Reduction Programs in Rosemead.
Recommendation: That the Beautification Commission provide feedback.
Presentation
4.
MATTERS FROM COMMISSION
CEQA: This item is not subject to the California Environmental Quality Act.
A.
Discussion of Community Clean-up Event
Staff will provide details of the upcoming June 22nd Community Clean-up.
B.
July 4th Chalkathon Contest
Staff will briefly share details about the July 4th Chalkathon Contest.
C.
Commissioners Comments
5.
ADJOURNMENT The next regular Beautification Commission meeting will be held on Wednesday, July 10, 2024, at 7:00 p.m. in the Council Chambers.

8845 Valley Boulevard; Rosemead Library, 8800 Valley Boulevard); and on the City's website (www.cityofrosemead.org)
